Running an Event End-to-End.hook: Track every guest **by name**, so gaps surface now, not at the door
points: Track **registration status by name**, not a running headcount
Build the **engagement-tracking plan** before the event starts
Chase **incomplete registrations early**, with real time to fix
Reconcile registrations against **actual attendance** afterwards
Running an Event End-to-End.scene: Registration for the firm's client breakfast opens. Two names show unconfirmed, and **the event is still weeks away**.
Running an Event End-to-End.move: Follow up with both now, **well before the event**
dos: Plan **who needs what materials** before the day
Feed **what went wrong** into the next event
donts: Don't rely on **a running headcount** alone
Don't treat each event as **a fresh start**

Event Management Tips: Checklists, Run S.hook: Most event problems are predictable, so **planning for them is the job**
points: Run every event on **three documents**: checklist, run sheet, contact sheet
Give every checklist line **an owner and a due date**
Confirm every vendor **48 hours before**
On the day, you are **the calm center**
Event Management Tips: Checklists, Run S.scene: The client breakfast starts at 8:00. At 7:20 **the caterer hasn't arrived**, Elias's projector won't connect, and **two guests are early**.
Event Management Tips: Checklists, Run S.move: Work the **run sheet and contact sheet**: call, delegate, greet
dos: Give each helper **one clear role** and the run sheet
Build **10 to 15 minutes** of slack in
Debrief **within a week** and update the template
donts: Don't keep the plan **in one person's head**

Sending Invites: Calendar Invites & Even.hook: A wrong title, time or link means **people miss the meeting**
points: Answer what, when, where, who and **what to prepare**
Always show **the time zone**
Save-the-date **six to eight weeks** ahead, invitation three to four
Change it by **updating the existing invite**
Sending Invites: Calendar Invites & Even.scene: Elias wants **a 45-minute call** next week with a client in London, a partner in New York and an expert in **Denver**.
Sending Invites: Calendar Invites & Even.move: Check availability, then send **one invite showing each zone**
job: Reminders at one week, one day
dos: Hide the guest list for **large external events**
Confirm invitees with Elias; **send from his calendar**
Cancel **through the calendar**, not by email
donts: Don't send **a new invite for every change**

Sending Intake Forms: Event Registration.hook: Collect what you need **before the meeting**, securely and in plain language
points: Ask **only what's needed**; extra questions lose finishers
Use the **firm's approved form tool**, never a personal account
Collect **every party involved** for the conflict check
Get **the attorney's approval** for client intake questions
Sending Intake Forms: Event Registration.line: Never ask a new client for **sensitive documents by email**
Sending Intake Forms: Event Registration.scene: Elias meets **a small construction company** on Monday and wants their details and **everyone in their dispute** beforehand.
Sending Intake Forms: Event Registration.move: Send a short, tested form with **a deadline and contact**
dos: Pre-fill what you know; keep it **phone-friendly**
Tell people **how their information is used**
Request documents through **the secure upload**
donts: Don't leave answers **sitting in the form**

CLE Management for Firm-Hosted Events.hook: When the firm hosts CLE, it is **the course provider**, with real duties
points: Each state sets **its own CLE rules**
Apply for approval **before each state's deadline**
Attendees' credit **depends on the paperwork**
Keep records **as long as each state requires**
CLE Management for Firm-Hosted Events.line: Say 'credit has been applied for' **until it is approved**
CLE Management for Firm-Hosted Events.scene: The firm hosts a two-hour webinar, 'Employment Law Update,' in **six weeks**, with one ethics hour, for **New York, New Jersey and California**.
CLE Management for Firm-Hosted Events.move: Check **all three states' approval rules** this week
dos: Collect **bar numbers and states** at registration
Keep **a CLE file** for every event

Speaker & Panelist Logistics for Confere.hook: A speaking slot runs on **the organizer's deadlines**, not the executive's
points: A speaking slot is **far more than a calendar entry**
Missing an organizer deadline can **cost the slot**
Confirm **the format** early: keynote, panel, fireside chat
Send Elias **one consolidated briefing** before the event
Speaker & Panelist Logistics for Confere.scene: Elias is a panelist **in three weeks**. The organizer wants his bio, headshot and pre-submitted questions **by end of week**.
Speaker & Panelist Logistics for Confere.move: Put each item on **one checklist with its due date**
job: Every item has a due date
dos: Confirm AV **with the venue directly**
Send slides **24-48 hours before** the deadline
donts: Don't treat it as **just another calendar item**

Sponsorship & Vendor Contract Basics for.hook: Sponsorships are **real contracts**, so verify you got what you paid for
points: Treat sponsorship and vendor agreements as **real obligations**
Check **every deliverable owed** against what's provided
Keep **the signed agreement on hand** at the event
Track **costs against value delivered**
Sponsorship & Vendor Contract Basics for.scene: At a sponsored event, you notice **the firm's logo is missing** from the printed program the agreement guarantees.
Sponsorship & Vendor Contract Basics for.move: Flag the gap to the organizer **in writing, promptly**
dos: Verify directly: **check the signage**
Assess value **before any renewal**

Live Event Moderation.hook: During the event, you keep it smooth **for audience and presenter alike**
points: Moderation is **active, real-time management** during the call
Follow the sequence: Reminder → Login → Attendance → **Monitor → Document → Follow-Up**
Catch technical problems **before the event starts**
Track **minimum attendance time** for CLE sessions
Live Event Moderation.scene: Ten minutes into Elias's webinar, **his audio starts cutting out**. The audience is **commenting in the chat**.
Live Event Moderation.move: Fix it quietly, **without disrupting his presentation** more than necessary
dos: Keep **a visible checklist** during the event
Document **every technical issue** as it happens
Confirm **introduction and materials** for speaking events

Post-Event Follow-Up & ROI Tracking.hook: An event's real value is made **in the follow-up**, not on the day
points: Build the follow-up list **during the event**
Follow up **within 48-72 hours**
Log outcomes in **the same relationship system**
Track **a simple ROI measure** per event
Post-Event Follow-Up & ROI Tracking.scene: Elias returns from a 3-day conference with **40 new contacts** and **no notes** on any of them.
Post-Event Follow-Up & ROI Tracking.move: Rebuild context, then send **specific, personal follow-ups**
dos: Reference **the specific conversation**
Record **leads, relationships, deals influenced**
donts: Don't collect cards with **no conversation notes**

High-Stakes Travel Disruption Management.hook: Solve for **what Elias would miss**, not just the flight
points: Disruption is **triage**: decide what must happen next
Find **the fixed point** and solve around it
Check **airline app and phone** in parallel
Send Elias **one clear plan**, not live narration
High-Stakes Travel Disruption Management.scene: Elias's connection to **a closing-day meeting** is cancelled. Options: **a red-eye** with two hours to spare, or a costlier private car.
High-Stakes Travel Disruption Management.move: Weigh both against his constraints; present **one clear recommendation**
dos: Be on it **before Elias's app tells him**
Keep **his hard constraints** on a standing note

Everyday Meeting Notes & Action Items.hook: Notes capture **decisions, actions and open questions**, never a transcript
points: Every action needs **an owner and a due date**
Write decisions as **clear statements**
Send notes **within 24 hours**, actions on top
Label **privileged notes** and limit who gets them
Everyday Meeting Notes & Action Items.scene: After a Harlow strategy call, your notes read: **'Discussed deposition. Expert maybe.** Budget concerns. Elias to think about it.'
Everyday Meeting Notes & Action Items.move: Rewrite as **decisions, owned actions with dates**, open questions
dos: Ask in the room: **'So we're agreed?'**
Mark privileged notes **when the attorney says**
donts: Don't record who said what, **not what was decided**
Don't write **'Someone will look into it'**

Board Meeting Preparation & Minute Draft.hook: Minutes are **a legal record** of what was decided, not a transcript
points: Most board work happens **in the days before**
Circulate packets with **real review time**
Record attendance, motions, seconders and **exact vote outcomes**
Use **neutral, factual language**
Board Meeting Preparation & Minute Draft.line: Never record opinions or disagreements; **capture decisions only**
Board Meeting Preparation & Minute Draft.scene: A motion is debated with real disagreement, **amended once**, and passes **4-1**. You're taking minutes live.
Board Meeting Preparation & Minute Draft.move: Record the motion, amendment, seconder and **the 4-1 vote**
dos: Keep **the packet structure** the same every time
Ask Elias or counsel **about sensitive topics**

Shareholder & Investor Meeting (AGM) Log.hook: AGMs carry **formal legal requirements** a routine board meeting doesn't
points: Confirm **the required notice period** for the jurisdiction
Track RSVPs **against quorum**
No quorum means **no valid business**
Add **proxy materials and voting procedures** to the packet
Shareholder & Investor Meeting (AGM) Log.line: Notice and quorum are **legal requirements**, not loose best practice
Shareholder & Investor Meeting (AGM) Log.scene: You're coordinating an AGM and realize **the notice went out late** for the jurisdiction's minimum period.
Shareholder & Investor Meeting (AGM) Log.move: Get it confirmed **before proceeding as scheduled**
dos: Apply **the board packet discipline**, scaled up
Confirm voting procedures **well in advance**
donts: Don't treat an AGM as **a bigger board meeting**

Executive Meeting Etiquette.hook: Your conduct on a call **reflects on Elias**, even when you're not presenting
points: Executive calls carry **a higher standard**
Etiquette means **removing friction**, not rigid formality
**Join early** to confirm the technology
Handle the mechanics **quietly in the background**
Executive Meeting Etiquette.line: Never let a tech issue **become Elias's problem** live
Executive Meeting Etiquette.scene: Thirty seconds before a prospective-client call, you see **the link is for the wrong time zone**. The client **may already be waiting**.
Executive Meeting Etiquette.move: Act right now: **reach the client** and get Elias connected
dos: Confirm **participants and roles** in advance
Mind **mute, framing and background**

Video Conferencing: Platform Admin (Zoom.hook: Most platform problems are **prevented by correct setup**, not solved live
points: Platform admin means **owning the settings**
Know **your firm's primary platform** well
Set waiting room, sharing and recording **before scheduling**
**Review account settings** periodically
Video Conferencing: Platform Admin (Zoom.scene: Elias's **confidential strategy call** with senior partners went out on **a general link** with no waiting room.
Video Conferencing: Platform Admin (Zoom.move: Secure the settings and **send the updated invite**
dos: Test **new formats** before they're needed live
Give **a backup person** platform access
Document **platform quirks** for the next person
donts: Don't use **the same defaults** for every meeting
Don't let **only one person** run meetings

Video Conferencing: Technical Troublesho.hook: Calm, structured triage **beats panic** almost every time
points: Most issues are **login, audio/video or screen-share**
**Get the call working** first; diagnose afterwards
Work through likely causes **in order**
Have **a backup channel** ready before high-stakes calls
Video Conferencing: Technical Troublesho.scene: Fifteen minutes before a critical client call, **the platform is down** for planned maintenance you didn't know about.
Video Conferencing: Technical Troublesho.move: Switch to **the backup channel** and tell participants now
dos: Keep **provider support contacts** ready
Test-run **unfamiliar setups** in advance
Tell participants calmly: **'one moment'**
donts: Don't meet a delay with **silence or panic**

Four SOPs That Keep Professional Develop.hook: Each SOP prevents **a specific, predictable failure**
points: Registration: **verify the provider** and approval first
Attendance: save certificates in **an audit-ready folder**
Upskilling: track **completion and ROI**, not just sessions
Recognition: **escalate negative publicity** immediately
Four SOPs That Keep Professional Develop.scene: A busy month: registrations and certificates get done, but **Reputation & Recognition** quietly slips **off the list**.
Four SOPs That Keep Professional Develop.move: Run **all four SOPs**, including the least urgent one
dos: Record confirmations and receipts **immediately**
Keep **bios current**

CLE / Compliance Tracking.hook: Compliance deadlines rarely extend, so **flag people early**
points: Log completed, pending and **the deadline per person**
An aggregate number **hides who's at risk**
Verify hours count: **right category, right jurisdiction**
Reconcile the tracker **against certificates on file**
CLE / Compliance Tracking.scene: The tracker shows the team on target overall, but one attorney is **short on ethics hours**, with a deadline approaching.
CLE / Compliance Tracking.move: Flag them now, **with real time left to act**
dos: Build **long lead times** into reminders
Track **each person individually**

Planning Professional Development.hook: Measure whether training **actually landed**, not just who attended
points: Offer **virtual and in-person** options
Set **an effectiveness metric** before each session
Gather feedback **immediately after**
Track outcomes **over time**, not just per session
Planning Professional Development.scene: A development session drew a full room, but **nobody defined how to measure** whether the content landed.
Planning Professional Development.move: Set **a clear effectiveness metric** before the next one
dos: Fit **varied schedules and locations**
Use past results to **adjust the next session**
donts: Don't repeat **a format regardless of results**

Membership Renewals.hook: A renewal tracker **catches lapses** before they happen
points: Track name, expiration, status and **follow-up owner**
Set reminders **well ahead of expiration**
**Automate reminders** once volume grows
Confirm **terms haven't changed** before renewing
Membership Renewals.scene: A renewal notice arrives for a membership **nobody has used** this year, at **a higher price**.
Membership Renewals.move: Check terms and use, **don't renew by default**
dos: Remind before the date, **not on notice arrival**
Review **the full tracker** periodically
donts: Don't rely on **memory** as volume grows

Ethics & Gift Compliance.hook: A modest courtesy **can still cross a compliance line**
points: Gift rules are **more precise than intuition** suggests
Know **the firm's gift policy** before accepting or offering
Log gifts **above the policy threshold**
Take **extra care with officials** and regulated parties
Ethics & Gift Compliance.line: When unsure, **ask before accepting or sending**
Ethics & Gift Compliance.scene: A vendor sends **an expensive holiday gift** to the office.
Ethics & Gift Compliance.move: Check the policy and threshold, **then ask before accepting**
dos: Log gifts **even when clearly appropriate**
Ask **the possibly-unnecessary question**

Professional Liability & Insurance Aware.hook: Spotting a possible claim **early gives the firm options**
points: Know that **malpractice coverage** exists and what it covers
Know **where policies and renewal dates** are filed
**Flag dissatisfaction language** immediately
Keep renewal dates **on the compliance calendar**
Professional Liability & Insurance Aware.line: Never assess **coverage or liability yourself**; send it to the attorney
Professional Liability & Insurance Aware.scene: A client emails: **"we're considering our options** given how this was handled."
Professional Liability & Insurance Aware.move: Flag it **to the attorney immediately**, and keep it confidential
dos: Handle it with **privileged-matter discretion**
Treat renewals as **hard deadlines**

Protecting the Brand Online.hook: A well-handled negative review **beats ten positive ones**
points: **Monitor proactively** for mentions and reviews
Respond **professionally and factually**
Apply **'need to know'**: The Vault
Escalate **legal threats or coordinated attacks**
Protecting the Brand Online.line: Never **escalate publicly**, however the comment is phrased
Protecting the Brand Online.scene: A harsh review of the firm appears overnight and is **gaining traction**.
Protecting the Brand Online.move: Draft **a considered, factual response**, never a heated one
dos: Take **a moment to draft**
Keep sensitive details in **the Cone of Silence**

points: Keep **an annual awards tracker**
Missing **eligibility, materials or deadline** disqualifies
Confirm donations were **actually fulfilled**
Keep documentation for **tax and reporting**
Awards, Recognition & Charitable Coordin.scene: You spot **a good-fit award** for Elias, but **its deadline passed** last week.
Awards, Recognition & Charitable Coordin.move: Add it to **the awards tracker** for next year
dos: Confirm eligibility **well before the deadline**
Track commitments **through to fulfillment**
donts: Don't rely on **someone remembering** an award

Building an Executive's Media & Speaking.hook: A current media kit turns press requests into **a same-day response**
points: Keep bio, headshot, talking points and **past coverage** ready
Hold **short and long** bio versions
Log past **media and speaking engagements**
**Refresh quarterly**, not on request
Building an Executive's Media & Speaking.scene: A journalist wants Elias's bio and headshot **in two hours**. The bio is **over a year old**, with an outdated role.
Building an Executive's Media & Speaking.move: Update the bio, **get it reviewed**, then send
dos: Keep **print and web** headshot formats
Review **before anything goes out**
donts: Don't update the bio **only when asked**
